cards.verse_text: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
cards.snippet: …You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.

cards.verse_text: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and defend the cause of the poor and needy.

cards.card_text: It's the one who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity.
cards.verse_text: He who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity, who refuses gain from extortion, whose hand never takes a bribe, who stops his ears against murderous plots and shuts his eyes tightly against evil—

cards.card_text: So Jeremiah turns to the LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously and examines the heart and mind.
cards.verse_text: O LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
